title: Swedish Midsummer Brown Butter Roasted New Potatoes

ingredients.item: small preserved lemon (or a squeeze of lemon juice)

steps: Heat. Heat a grill to medium, or the oven to 200 °C.
Parboil. Boil the potatoes in salted water until about 90% cooked, 10–15 minutes. Drain and steam dry.
Parcel. Lay on a double layer of foil, dot with butter and seal tightly so no butter escapes.
Cook. Cook 35–45 minutes; check at 35 and flip for more even colour.
Greens. Toss asparagus and green onions in oil and salt, grill on high until charred, then chop.
Finish. Mince the herbs and preserved lemon. Toss everything with the brown butter from the parcel, season and serve.
